headline: Gold heads for steepest weekly decline since March on Fed rate fears
summary: Gold prices fell for a fifth consecutive day, tracking toward their steepest weekly loss since March. The metal was weighed down by expectations of further Federal Reserve interest rate hikes and a sharp sell-off in technology stocks.
why: Gold is a traditional non-yielding safe-haven asset whose prices are highly sensitive to real interest rates and dollar strength.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Higher interest rate expectations increase the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding bullion.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Hawkish central bank signaling and tech sector liquidations reduced investor interest in precious metals.
